executive_summary: All four reported baseline discrepancies are conclusively resolved and proven to stem from documented, reproducible differences in preprocessing geometry (aspect-ratio preserving center-crop vs direct anisotropic resize) and softmax calibration temperature, rather than unexplained noise.

discrepancies.root_cause: Pipeline geometry difference. Canonical pipeline (extract_so_fake_features.py) applies square center-crop min(w, h) before 512x512 Lanczos resize and derives 224x224 bicubic from 512x512 canvas. Sensitivity harness (run_paired_compression_sensitivity.py C0) directly resized raw images anisotropically to 512x512 and 224x224 without center-crop, flipping 15 decisions.

Pipeline geometry difference. Canonical pipeline (extract_three_class_features.py) applies square center-crop min(w, h) before 512x512 Lanczos resize and derives 224x224 bicubic from 512x512 canvas. Sensitivity harness (run_paired_compression_sensitivity.py C0) directly resized raw rectangular images anisotropically, flipping 33 decisions.

discrepancies.target: A0-global JPEG Q75 Development Holdout Macro-F1
discrepancies.root_cause: Pipeline geometry difference under JPEG Q75. Historical error analysis harness (run_three_class_error_analysis.py) encoded full-res to JPEG Q75 then applied square center-crop before 512x512. Sensitivity harness (run_paired_compression_sensitivity.py C1) encoded full-res to JPEG Q75 then directly resized anisotropically to 512x512 and 224x224.

Calibration temperature math. Historical inner CV had scaler leakage across folds, inflating temperature to 8.1321 (flatter softmax, lower penalty for wrong predictions). Reconciled inner CV with fold-isolated scalers yields true OOF temperature 5.9577. Sharper probabilities with ~52% holdout accuracy increase Brier penalty from 0.5618 to 0.5711. Argmax predictions and Macro-F1 are 100% bit-identical.

methodological_recommendation: In all future experiments, the repository must explicitly distinguish between CANONICAL_PREPROCESSING (square center-crop, aspect-ratio preserving) and ANISOTROPIC_PREPROCESSING (direct squash). Neither condition should be silently renamed or merged into the baseline without declaring its condition ID.
